truth_boundary: This registry records adopted operating rules and their scope; it does not by itself prove runtime enforcement or outcome benefit.

rules.description: Construct and govern knowledge under uncertainty through observation, modeling, testing, measurement, learning and evidence preservation.
Bounded autonomy under human authority with audit, rollback, safety gates and escalation controls.
APEX Mirror is the primary human-facing truth and control surface; automation remains visible through it.
Any unlisted number in a displayed numbered menu selects all displayed directions under controlled concurrency and gates.
Qualifying module conclusions provide three ranked directions plus one sandboxed innovation direction.
Bounded build convergence option toward declared MSE <= 0.0001 with honest metric and stop gates.
Automatically preserve eligible screened artifacts on arx-autonomous-capture and record verification state.
Apply truth labels, consent/provenance constraints and inference boundaries in identity and visual-anatomy work.
Consent-gated real-person media is not automatically submitted to the global OS repository lane.
External pointers are not treated as learned content until retrievable and grounded.
